## Description

Please include a summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them. If this fixes an open issue, link it here.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update / Examples improvement
- [ ] Code refactoring / Performance optimization

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (C Google Style / Python Ruff).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`uv run pytest`).
- [ ] Formatting and type checks pass (`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run mypy src/`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if necessary.
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials or secret keys are present in code or examples.
